title: Spec mailbox.send and mailbox_halt in @lanyard/shared
description:
Write the canonical mailbox contract once. Agent spec leaf dual-writes the same shape. Do not implement send.

## Cross-repo
Agent spec leaf (child of lac-r9w): copy these types field-for-field into packages/gateway-core/src/mailbox.ts and lanyard-agent/contracts/mailbox-v1/. Platform is canonical. If you land first, the agent worker copies you. If they land first, diff against this file and the map; do not add extra fields.

## Locked product rules that apply
Locked product rules (map 2026-08-25, do not invent):
- Gateway owns send → append → wake. Browser SSE is a view, not the hop chain.
- room = BFF thread_id. BFF owns roster. Fail closed (forbidden / not_found).
- mailbox.send({to, room, text}) always wakes to. One to per send. from is the session persona, never spoofed.
- Tool is canonical. @Name in model prose also sends. One BFF parser. Dedupe on nonce (externalMessageId), not raw text.
- Extra @ in a tool-call body is text only. Only `to` wakes.
- Human channel message wakes lead PLUS any @ mentions (dedupe).
- Wake context is the room tail. Kill today's previous-reply-as-the-whole-prompt wire.
- Same change adds mailbox.send and retires mention-hop (lp-znef.3 / decideWake hop). One wake brain. No double-wake.
- 1:1 hop: from need not be a member of Jack↔to. No Bill bubble in Fizz 1:1. Fizz model gets hidden Bill text + room tail. Bill 1:1: text-only "A message has been sent to Fizz." No tap. Channel hop from a 1:1: no notice; Bill's bubble is in the channel.
- Guest in another 1:1 is forbidden. Fizz never writes Bill↔Jack.
- Jack is not a mailbox address. Talk to Jack is a normal room message.
- Fuse is hidden: 40 msgs/room/rolling hour AND ≤8 consecutive a2a without a human. Both reset on human message or halt. Trip = one system line, no Resume.
- Halt = abort in-flight + freeze new wakes until Jack speaks. Jack's next message unfreezes and is a normal wake (lead + @s).
- Fan-out: serial per room (ThreadTurnQueue). Two rooms in parallel.
- Cron = mailbox.send into a real thread_id. from = named persona. Dead room = fail closed.
- Any persona in the room can create schedule or workflow via existing tools. Default room = the room they created it in. Keep list/detail edit/pause/delete. Remove create plus + wizard + top-left plus.
- Composer @ = agents, then provisioned connector enums (Google Workspace, HubSpot, WhatsApp, GitHub). @connector / @HubSpot marks the connector for the in-room agent. No wake. File @ dead everywhere. Plus = attach or vault.
- Persistence: API over the chat store. No durable mailbox outbox in v1.
- No mailbox UI. No tool dump in channels. Do not restore Hermes as a Lanyard product runtime.
- Do not reopen lac-xsb, lac-bx3, lac-37a, lp-cxhb. Do not parent under lp-8sh4. Do not treat lp-8sh4.6 as talk.
- Prove on live MockLab. Protocol is not blocked on lp-jnrj; only the live image-roll / nine-check gate is.

## Types to publish
Put TypeScript in portal/packages/shared/src/mailbox/ (index.ts, send.ts, errors.ts, tests) and JSON schema in contracts/mailbox-v1/mailbox.schema.json (same layout as contracts/group-rooms-v1).

mailbox.send input (model-visible):
- to: persona id (one). Not a list. Not a user id. Not "Jack".
- room: BFF thread_id (branded string). Not a channel name.
- text: string. No attachments in v1.
- nonce: string. This IS externalMessageId on the wire.

Gateway stamps (not model-settable):
- from: session persona id
- tenant_id

mailbox_halt input:
- room: BFF thread_id
Only lead tool + Jack's button. Non-lead persona calling halt is forbidden.

Error codes (string union, fail closed):
- not_found (unknown room or unknown to)
- forbidden (from not on channel roster; guest write to someone else's 1:1; non-lead halt)
- frozen (halt or fuse freeze in effect)
- fuse_tripped (send that would exceed 40/hour or 8 consecutive a2a)
- bad_to (Jack, self, empty, connector id mistaken as persona)
- dead_room (scheduled fire into a deleted thread)

Nonce:
- Tool: model/gateway generates UUID per send.
- Prose @ path (later leaf): nonce = `prose:{turnId}:{to}:{room}`.
- Dedupe key is nonce only. Same nonce → idempotent no-op (no second bubble, no second wake).
- Do NOT dedupe on (from,to,room,text).

Event mapping (no new SSE type):
- Channel / same-room send → RelayChatEvent message_send, speaker=from, in room, plus Wake(to).
- 1:1 hop → no message_send in target; system_notice in origin 1:1; hidden wake body to `to`.
- Halt freeze and fuse trip → system_notice already in ChatHistoryEvent (chat-store.ts). Reuse it.

BFF append API sketch (types only here; BFF leaf implements):
- Internal POST that gateway calls. Body = send input + from stamp.
- Responses: ok + message_id | error code above.

## Files / areas
- portal/packages/shared/src/mailbox/ (new)
- portal/packages/shared/src/index.ts export
- contracts/mailbox-v1/mailbox.schema.json (new)
- contracts/mailbox-v1/README.md naming the wayfinder map as SoT
- Tests next to the types (shared vitest)

## Fail-closed
Illegal states unrepresentable: to is a single branded PersonaId; room is ThreadId; from is not on the model tool schema.

## Worker collision
You own packages/shared/src/mailbox/** and contracts/mailbox-v1/**. Do not edit bff/src or apps/web. Parser/UI workers will import you later.

## Unlocks MockLab check
All of them, indirectly. Nothing ships without these names.

What NOT to do:
- Do not build a mailbox inbox, receipts UI, or tappable hop cards.
- Do not add a durable outbox table.
- Do not reopen or parent under lac-xsb, lac-bx3, lac-37a, lp-cxhb, lp-8sh4.
- Do not patch lp-8sh4.6 (composer 503) and call it talk.
- Do not restore Hermes as the product runtime.
- Do not put tool traces in the shared channel.
- Do not make Jack a mailbox `to`.
- Do not let Fizz append to Bill↔Jack.
- Do not split mailbox.send and mention-hop retirement into two merges that can double-wake.
- Do not write Playwright QA for Jack's nine MockLab checks.
- Do not recreate scheduled-task product (lp-jzl / lp-fn5). This epic only moves create onto agent tools and kills create chrome.
design: Brand PersonaId and ThreadId at the boundary the same way wake-policy.ts brands PersonaId (no colon, no whitespace). Export MailboxSendInput, MailboxHaltInput, MailboxErrorCode, MailboxAppendResult. Schema version 1. Do not import BFF chat-store types into shared (keep shared free of sqlite). Connector ids are NOT personas; export a separate ConnectorMark enum google|hubspot|whatsapp|github for the parser leaf to use.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] mailbox.send / mailbox_halt types exported from @lanyard/shared
- [ ] contracts/mailbox-v1/mailbox.schema.json matches the TS fields
- [ ] nonce documented as externalMessageId
- [ ] error union is not_found|forbidden|frozen|fuse_tripped|bad_to|dead_room
- [ ] from is absent from the model-visible tool schema
- [ ] tests cover one-to, nonce identity, branded parse failures
- [ ] no send runtime, no UI, no BFF route in this PR
notes: Review approve. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/651 HEAD f1693b5f (rebased on main after #648-650). Waiting CI then merge.
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/651 (merged fd7b29d9). Canonical mailbox.send/halt types in @lanyard/shared + contracts/mailbox-v1. nonce=externalMessageId; errors not_found|forbidden|frozen|fuse_tripped|bad_to|dead_room; from not on model schema. Shared vitest mailbox 25 passed. Portal CI red on pre-existing CP fake-sandbox flake (main already red); this PR did not touch control-plane.

title: Live: Google OAuth token must drive GWS CLI on the user sandbox
description:
Live MockLab 2026-08-25: Taste Connect Google PASS (operator@example.com Connected on Catalog + API). After OAuth there is nothing for the agent to call. Jack lock: Google connected → OAuth token available → GWS CLI tools callable by the agent. Chip paint waits.

Design already closed on lp-xhf4.7 (e5b4d735 / #570): first-use inject sets GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_TOKEN; gws reads that env. lp-xhf4.6 lazy inject on user sandbox. Frozen in docs/architecture/portal-connectors.md §3/§5. Client-core pack gws (skills/gws + productivity-gws). Command map: gws gmail/calendar/drive → action_class.

Live miss to verify (hypothesis, discard if wrong):
- CP injectUserConnector + POST /internal/.../inject exist. BFF has injectUserConnector client. No chat/send caller found. Only scheduled-task-connectors.ts injects.
- lanyard-agent has no gws / GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_TOKEN hits. Tools are skills + CLI on the box, not MCP.
- gws binary + pack may be missing on the live Daytona image.

Ship: wire first-use inject on the path the agent actually takes, put gws + gws skills on the user box, prove one GWS CLI call with the injected token. Worktrees only. PR to main. Do not merge. Do not deploy.
acceptance_criteria: After Connect Google on MockLab, first agent use injects GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_TOKEN onto that user sandbox (not the tenant box). gws on the box reads that token (not ~/.config/gws as SoT). title: Path-first OAuth callback 404s Unknown tenant on APP_HOST (bare /api/connectors/:id/oauth/callback)
description:
Live path-first host is https://app.withlanyard.com/mocklab/.... BFF OAuth start builds redirect_uri as origin + /api/connectors/{id}/oauth/callback (no tenant slug). Google already received https://app.withlanyard.com/api/connectors/google/oauth/callback and failed redirect_uri_mismatch. Jack is adding that URI (plus HubSpot/GitHub equivalents) in provider consoles.

After Google redirects to that bare /api path on app.withlanyard.com, createTenantMiddleware cannot resolve a slug (Host is APP_HOST, path has no /mocklab) and 404s Unknown tenant. CloudFront remaps 404 to HTML.

Same pattern as office DS (lp-xcu.1):
1. Treat GET /api/connectors/:connectorId/oauth/callback and /{slug}/api/connectors/:connectorId/oauth/callback as deferred-tenant (like isOfficeDocumentServerPath).
2. Callback handler already has signed state with tenant_id. When tenant is deferred / missing slug, resolve tenant from parsedState.tenant_id via tenantResolver (by id), attach it, then continue existing google/hubspot callback. Keep the mismatch check when a path-prefix tenant IS present (slug must match state).
3. Do NOT change connectorOAuthCallbackRedirectPath (keep /api/connectors/${id}/oauth/callback) — one URI per provider for all tenants.
4. Tests: bare /api/connectors/google/oauth/callback on Host app.withlanyard.com with valid signed state for MockLab-like tenant succeeds (no 404 Unknown tenant). Spoofed slug vs state still 401/403 as today. HubSpot same if tests already exist.
